events.title: Section 232 tariffs on UAS and UAS components
events.why_it_matters: 100%/25% national-security duties plus a delayed component tariff aim to onshore drones and cut foreign (esp. China) supply-chain dependence.
events.what_to_watch: HTSUS annex effective dates, onshoring exemptions, and pricing at DJI-exposed commercial/defense buyers.

events.title: Presidential memo to rebuild Navy and U.S. shipbuilding base
events.why_it_matters: Opens a foreign-design/U.S.-yard investment model, extra public-yard capacity, and tanker/Ro-Ro procurement that reallocates defense and maritime capex.
events.what_to_watch: 60–120 day War/Navy acquisition plans and which U.S. and allied yards qualify for 10 U.S.C. 8679 waivers.

events.title: Canada Sec. 338 offset duties delayed then effective
events.why_it_matters: Alcohol, dairy, and motor-vehicle offset duties on Canadian imports were paused three days for talks, then set to hit 12:01 a.m. ET Aug 22.
events.what_to_watch: CBP collection/refunds and whether a further suspension or Canadian concession follows.

events.title: SEC proposes Regulation Crypto Assets
events.why_it_matters: Creates a tailored token-offering regime (up to $5M startup / $75M fundraising exemptions) instead of forcing full '33 Act registration.
events.what_to_watch: Comment file through Oct 20 and whether exchanges/issuers treat it as a capital-formation thaw.

events.title: National Space Transportation Policy (NSPM-17)
events.why_it_matters: Federal ranges, spectrum, export policy, and a 1,000-launch-by-2030 goal are a direct industrial-policy tailwind for commercial launch.
events.what_to_watch: 180-day range-scheduling and spectrum reports from War/NASA/DOT/FCC.

events.title: OFAC alert on Iranian Hormuz passage 'tolls'
events.why_it_matters: Treats Iranian strait fees, insurance, or in-kind payments as sanctions exposure, raising tanker/compliance risk on a chokepoint that already tightened oil balances.
events.what_to_watch: Tanker fixtures, war-risk insurance, and any further SDN designations under Operation Economic Outcast.

events.title: FTC-state settlement unwinds Zillow-Redfin rental ILS pact
events.why_it_matters: Forces Redfin back into multifamily listing ads after a $100M exit payment, a housing-platform antitrust overlay rather than a demand shock.
events.what_to_watch: E.D. Va. court approval and Redfin’s six-month re-entry spend.

events.title: House-Senate must reconcile FY2027 continuing resolution
events.why_it_matters: Senate CR runs to Dec 11 vs. House to Dec 4; a deal after recess would push shutdown risk past October 1.
events.what_to_watch: House action after ~Aug 31 return and whether anomalies/OMB-grant delay survive conference.

events.title: July CPI print
events.why_it_matters: Headline 3.4% y/y and core 2.5% cooled only a tenth, leaving Warsh little cover if he wants to sound dovish.
events.what_to_watch: Shelter/core services persistence into Wednesday’s PCE.

events.title: August refunding 10-year and 30-year auctions stop out at multi-decade highs
events.why_it_matters: 10y 4.683% and 30y 5.216% high-yields confirm term-premium stress into Jackson Hole.
events.what_to_watch: Sept 9–10 reopenings ($39B 10y / $22B 30y) and any Bessent buyback offset.

events.title: China keeps 1-year and 5-year LPRs unchanged
events.why_it_matters: 15th consecutive hold (3.00%/3.50%) signals no broad credit easing despite weak activity.
events.what_to_watch: Any NDRC/PBOC targeted tools instead of LPR cuts.

events.title: S&P Case-Shiller and FHFA home-price indexes
events.why_it_matters: Housing inflation is still a large CPI/PCE shelter input even if sales volumes are second-tier.
events.what_to_watch: Year-on-year deceleration vs. sticky owners’ equivalent rent.

events.title: July PCE, personal income, and Q2 GDP second estimate
events.why_it_matters: Last major inflation print before Warsh’s Jackson Hole debut.
events.what_to_watch: Core PCE vs. 2% and real spending vs. income.

events.title: Jackson Hole symposium; Warsh keynote
events.why_it_matters: First Jackson Hole as Chair after a 9–3 July hold at 3.50–3.75%, with long yields already at multi-year highs.
events.what_to_watch: Aug 28 ~10:00 a.m. ET speech for inflation framework and independence language, not a rate signal.

events.title: Deere Q3 FY2026 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Ag/construction bellwether beat and raised FY net-income guide to $4.75–$5.0B.
events.what_to_watch: Dealer inventories, tariff-refund commentary, and FY26 order book.

events.title: Nvidia Q2 FY2027 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Single largest AI-capex print of the window; a miss or cautious guide would hit semis, hyperscalers, and the Nasdaq together.
events.what_to_watch: Data-center revenue, Blackwell ramp, gross margin, and customer capex language.

events.title: CrowdStrike Q2 FY2027 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Cybersecurity sector bellwether reporting the same night as Nvidia.
events.what_to_watch: Net-new ARR, competitive commentary, and operating margin.

events.title: Marvell Q2 FY2027 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Custom AI/cloud silicon read-through one day after Nvidia.
events.what_to_watch: Whether results clear ~$2.7B ±5% revenue guide and 58–59% non-GAAP GM.

catcher.coverage_assessment: Primary scan produced zero events, so this catcher is the full book. Highest-signal cluster is past-window Section 232/338 trade actions plus OFAC Hormuz, and the upcoming Warsh Jackson Hole / PCE / Nvidia cluster.
catcher.biggest_gap: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's first Jackson Hole speech on 2026-08-28
